title: Anne of Green Gables
author: Lucy Maud Montgomery
description: 《绿山墙的安妮》是加拿大著名女作家露西·莫德·蒙哥马利（L. M. Montgomery）于 1908 年出版的长篇经典小说。故事发生在中国读者熟知的加拿大爱德华王子岛。老兄妹马修和马里拉原本打算从孤儿院领养一个男孩来帮忙做农活，却因传达失误误收养了孤儿女孩安妮·雪莉（Anne Shirley）。安妮拥有极其丰富的想象力、炽热敏感的灵魂以及永不言败的乐观性格。她的到来给平静肃穆的绿山墙农场和整个阿文莉小镇带来了无尽的欢声笑语与温情蜕变。本书语言优美生动，涵盖了大量描写大自然与真挚情感的经典名句，是学习高级英语词汇与修辞表达的极佳素材。

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Mrs. Rachel Lynde is Surprised
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 1 章：雷切尔·林德太太大吃一惊

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Rachel Lynde lived just where the Avonlea main road dipped down into a little hollow, fringed with alders and ladies' eardrops and traversed by a brook that had its source away back in the woods of the old Cuthbert place. It was known to be a intricate, headlong brook in its earliest course through those woods, with dark secrets of pool and cascade; but by the time it reached Lynde's Hollow it was a quiet, well-conducted little stream, for not even a brook could run past Mrs. Rachel Lynde's door without due regard for decency and decorum.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔·林德太太住的地方，正是阿文莉主干道俯冲进一个小低谷的位置。低谷两旁环绕着桤木和吊钟花，一条小溪穿流而过，小溪的源头一直延伸到旧卡斯伯特庄园的树林深处。据人们所知，那条小溪在最初穿过树林时是一条水流急促、曲折蜿蜒的小溪，藏着水潭和瀑布的神秘暗流；但当它流到林德低谷时，已变成了一条安静、循规蹈矩的小溪流，因为甚至连一条小溪从雷切尔·林德太太门前流过，也得恪守体面与礼貌。

paragraphs.en: It probably was conscious that Mrs. Rachel sat at her window, keeping a sharp eye on everything that passed, from brooks and children up, and that if she noticed anything odd or out of place she would never rest until she had ferreted out the whys and wherefores thereof.
paragraphs.zh: 它大概也意识到了雷切尔太太正坐在窗前，用敏锐的眼睛注视着经过的一切，从小溪到小孩无一例外；如果她注意到任何奇怪或离谱的事，不把其中的来龙去脉打听个水落石出，她就决不罢休。

paragraphs.en: There are plenty of people, in Avonlea and out of it, who can attend to their own neighbor's business by dint of neglecting their own; but Mrs. Rachel Lynde was one of those capable creatures who can manage their own concerns and those of other folks into the bargain. She was a notable housewife; her work was always done and well done; she "ran" the Sewing Circle, helped manage the Sunday-school, and was the strongest prop of the Church Aid Society and Foreign Missions Auxiliary.
paragraphs.zh: 在阿文莉小镇内外，有许许多多靠着忽视自家事务而去插手邻居事情的人；但雷切尔·林德太太属于那种干练的人物，既能打理好自家的琐事，还能顺便管理好别人的事情。她是一位出色的主妇；她的家务活总是做得又快又好；她主持着缝纫协会，协助管理主日学校，还是教会救济会和外宣辅助会最强有力的支柱。

paragraphs.en: Yet here was Matthew Cuthbert, at three o'clock on a summer afternoon, driving calmly out of his lane in his best suit of clothes and his buggy, which was plain proof that he was going out of Avonlea! Where on earth was Matthew going, and why was he going there?
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在夏季一个下午的三点钟，马修·卡斯伯特竟然穿着他最好的衣服，驾着小马车平平静静地从巷子里开出来，这清楚地证明了他要离开阿文莉！马修究竟要去哪里？他为什么要去那里？

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Rachel pondered until tea-time, and then set out across the orchard to Green Gables. Marilla Cuthbert greeted her warmly in the tidy kitchen.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔太太思索到下午茶时间，然后穿过果园前往绿山墙。马里拉·卡斯伯特在整洁的厨房里热情地招呼了她。

paragraphs.en: "Matthew has gone to Bright River," Marilla explained with a calm, unruffled smile. "We are adopting a little boy from an orphan asylum in Nova Scotia to help us on the farm."
paragraphs.zh: “马修去亮河镇了，”马里拉带着平静镇定的微笑解释道。“我们正准备从新斯科舍省的孤儿院领养一个小男孩，来农场帮马修干活。”

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Matthew Cuthbert is Surprised
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 2 章：马修·卡斯伯特大吃一惊

paragraphs.en: Matthew Cuthbert reached the Bright River station just as the evening train was departing. No boy was in sight on the long wooden platform, only a slender girl with long red braids sitting on a pile of shingles.
paragraphs.zh: 马修·卡斯伯特到达亮河车站时，晚班火车正准备驶离。长长的木制站台上看不到任何男孩的影子，只有一个瘦弱的女孩坐在木瓦堆上，扎着两条长长的红辫子。

paragraphs.en: She wore a faded, oversized yellow dress and held a worn carpetbag tightly in her lap. Her large eyes shone with imagination and vivid wonder as she approached Matthew with eager steps.
paragraphs.zh: 她穿着一件褪色的、过大的黄衣服，腿上紧紧抱着一只破旧的毯子提包。当她带着热切的脚步走向马修时，她的双眼闪烁着想象力与生动的惊奇。

paragraphs.en: "I suppose you are Mr. Matthew Cuthbert of Green Gables?" she asked in a clear, sweet voice. "I was beginning to fear you weren't coming for me after all! I was imagining all the things that might have happened to you."
paragraphs.zh: “我想您一定就是绿山墙的马修·卡斯伯特先生吧？”她用清脆甜美的声音问道。“我刚才都在担心您是不是不来接我了呢！我一直在想象您可能遇到的各种意外。”

paragraphs.en: Matthew's shy heart melted as they drove home beneath the blossoming wild plum and apple trees. The girl chattered endlessly about the beauty of Prince Edward Island, naming the avenue of birch trees the 'White Way of Delight'.
paragraphs.zh: 当他们驾车行驶在盛开的野李树和苹果树下回家时，马修害羞的心融化了。女孩滔滔不绝地讲述着爱德华王子岛的美丽，将桦树大道命名为“欢愉的白光大道”。

paragraphs.en: "Isn't it wonderful that there are so many things to love in this world?" she exclaimed, leaning forward in the buggy to breathe in the fragrant evening air. "I'm so glad I'm going to live with you at Green Gables!"
paragraphs.zh: “这个世界上有这么多值得去爱的事物，难道不是很棒吗？”她倾身向前，深深吸入傍晚芳香的空气，大声呼喊。“我真高兴能和你们一起住在绿山墙！”

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Marilla Cuthbert is Surprised
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 3 章：马里拉·卡斯伯特大吃一惊

paragraphs.en: When Matthew and the red-haired girl arrived at Green Gables, Marilla Cuthbert met them at the kitchen doorway in sheer bewilderment and sudden dismay.
paragraphs.zh: 当马修和红发女孩到达绿山墙时，马里拉·卡斯伯特在厨房门口接到了他们，眼中满是茫然与突如其来的沮丧。

paragraphs.en: "Matthew, where is the boy?" Marilla exclaimed, staring at the child in utter surprise. "We asked Mrs. Spencer to bring us a boy from the asylum!"
paragraphs.zh: “马修，男孩在哪里？”马里拉惊呼道，十分吃惊地盯着这个孩子。“我们明明让斯宾塞太太从孤儿院带个男孩回来的！”

paragraphs.en: The little girl dropped her carpetbag onto the floor and burst into passionate tears. "You don't want me!" she cried. "I might have known it was too beautiful to last! Nobody ever wanted me!"
paragraphs.zh: 小女孩把毯子包掉在地上，大声痛哭起来。“你们不要我！”她哭喊道。“我早该知道这太美好了，不可能长久！从来没有人要过我！”

paragraphs.en: "Well, well, don't cry, child," Marilla said gently, softening her tone. "We won't turn you out into the night. What is your name?"
paragraphs.zh: “好了，好了，别哭了，孩子，”马里拉温和地说，语气缓和了下来。“我们不会把你赶到夜色里的。你叫什么名字？”

paragraphs.en: "Call me Cordelia," she pleaded, looking up with tear-filled eyes, "or at least Anne spelled with an E. An Anne spelled without an E looks so plain, but Anne with an E has so much more dignity!"
paragraphs.zh: “叫我科迪莉亚吧，”她含着眼泪央求道，“或者至少叫我带 E 的安妮（Anne）。不带 E 的 Anne 看起来太平淡了，但带 E 的 Anne 看起来高雅多了！”

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Morning at Green Gables
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 4 章：绿山墙的清晨时光

paragraphs.en: The sun was shining brightly when Anne woke up the next morning at Green Gables. She rushed to the window and looked out in sheer delight.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天早晨，当安妮在绿山墙醒来时，阳光明媚。她冲到窗前，满心欢喜地向外望去。

paragraphs.en: Below her window, a huge cherry tree was in full white bloom, casting gentle shadows over the green grass. Beyond the orchard, the brook sparkled in the morning sunlight, and far away, the blue waters of the Gulf of St. Lawrence glinted under the clear sky.
paragraphs.zh: 在她的窗下，一棵巨大的樱花树正盛开着洁白的花朵，在绿色的草地上投下柔和的阴影。果园之外，小溪在晨光中闪闪发光，远方圣劳伦斯湾湛蓝的水面在晴空下烁烁生辉。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, Marilla!" Anne cried as she came downstairs for breakfast. "This is the most beautiful place in the whole world! I never dreamed of anything so lovely!"
paragraphs.zh: “哦，马里拉！”当安妮下楼吃早餐时大声呼喊。“这是全天下最美丽的地方！我做梦都没梦到过这么美好的地方！”

paragraphs.en: Marilla looked at her thoughtfully. "Eat your breakfast, Anne," she said calmly. "We have a busy day ahead of us, and talking won't get the dishes washed."
paragraphs.zh: 马里拉若有所思地看着她。“吃你的早餐吧，安妮，”她平静地说。“我们今天有很多活要干，光说话可洗不了碗。”

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Anne’s History
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 5 章：安妮的身世与往事

paragraphs.en: While Marilla washed the breakfast dishes, Anne sat by the window and shared the story of her early childhood.
paragraphs.zh: 当马里拉洗早餐碗碟时，安妮坐在窗边，分享了她童年早期的故事。

paragraphs.en: "I was born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia," Anne explained softly. "My father was Walter Shirley, a high school teacher, and my mother was Bertha Shirley. They were both very poor, but they loved each other dearly."
paragraphs.zh: “我出生在新斯科舍省的波林布鲁克，”安妮轻声解释道。“我父亲沃尔特·雪莉是一名高中教师，我母亲是伯莎·雪莉。他们当时都很穷，但他们非常相爱。”

paragraphs.en: She paused, looking out at the blooming orchard. "They both died of fever when I was just a baby, so Mrs. Thomas took me in. I helped take care of her four children until Mr. Thomas passed away, and then I went to live with Mrs. Hammond."
paragraphs.zh: 她停顿了一下，看着外面盛开的果园。“在我还只是个婴儿的时候，他们就双双死于发烧，所以托马斯太太收留了我。我帮她照顾她的四个孩子，直到托马斯先生过世，然后我又去和哈蒙德太太一起生活。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla listened in quiet sympathy as Anne described years of hard work, taking care of three pairs of twins before finally being sent to the Hopeton Orphanage.
paragraphs.zh: 当安妮讲述多年艰苦劳作、在最终被送往霍普顿孤儿院之前照顾三对双胞胎的经历时，马里拉默默地倾听着，心中充满了同情。

paragraphs.en: "It wasn't a very happy life, Marilla," Anne concluded with a faint smile, "but I always imagined nice things to keep my spirits up!"
paragraphs.zh: “那并不是一段非常快乐的生活，马里拉，”安妮带着淡淡的微笑总结道，“但我总是想象美好的事物来让自己振作起来！”

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Marilla Makes Up Her Mind
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 6 章：马里拉下定了决心

paragraphs.en: Marilla spent the afternoon driving Anne back to White Sands to discuss the adoption mistake with Mrs. Spencer.
paragraphs.zh: 下午，马里拉驾车带着安妮返回白沙镇，向斯宾塞太太询问领养失误的事情。

paragraphs.en: Along the road, Anne gazed out at the shining sea and blossoming orchards, chattering happily about her love for nature and dreams of true friendship.
paragraphs.zh: 沿途，安妮注视着闪光的海洋和盛开的果园，快乐地滔滔不绝地讲述着她对大自然的热爱和对真挚友谊的向往。

paragraphs.en: When they arrived, Mrs. Spencer offered to give Anne to Peter Blewett's wife, a harsh and demanding woman known for treating orphans cruelly.
paragraphs.zh: 当她们到达时，斯宾塞太太提出把安妮转送给彼得·布莱威特的妻子，后者是一个以严酷虐待孤儿闻名的刻薄女人。

paragraphs.en: Observing Mrs. Blewett's stern, cold face, Marilla felt a sudden surge of protective compassion for the lonely, imaginative child.
paragraphs.zh: 看到布莱威特太太严厉冷酷的面容，马里拉心中突然对这个孤独、富有想象力的孩子产生了一股保护性的同情。

paragraphs.en: "No," Marilla declared firmly, taking Anne by the hand. "Matthew and I have decided to keep her at Green Gables after all."
paragraphs.zh: “不，”马里拉紧紧握住安妮的手坚决地说，“马修和我决定还是把她留在绿山墙。”

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Anne Says Her Prayers
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 7 章：安妮做祷告

paragraphs.en: "Now, Anne," said Marilla when they returned to Green Gables, "it is time for you to learn your bedtime prayers."
paragraphs.zh: “现在，安妮，”当她们回到绿山墙时马里拉说，“该学睡前祷告了。”

paragraphs.en: Anne looked up in surprise. "I've never said a prayer in my life, Marilla," she admitted honestly. "Mrs. Thomas told me that God made my hair red on purpose, and I've never felt very close to Him since."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮惊讶地抬头。“我一辈子都没做过祷告，马里拉，”她坦白道。“托马斯太太告诉我，上帝是故意把我的头发变成红色的，从那以后我感觉和他不是很亲近。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla shook her head in dismay and instructed Anne to kneel by the bedside.
paragraphs.zh: 马里拉沮丧地摇了摇头，指导安妮跪在床边。

paragraphs.en: Anne folded her hands and looked out the window at the starlit sky. "Dear God," she began eloquently, "I thank You for the White Way of Delight and the Lover's Lane. Please let me stay at Green Gables, and make me pretty when I grow up. Amen."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮合拢双手，看着窗外星光闪烁的夜空。“亲爱的上帝，”她雄辩地开始道，“感谢您赐予欢愉的白光大道和情侣路。请让我留在绿山墙，并让我长大后变漂亮。阿门。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla sighed gently, realizing how much patient guidance this fiery, imaginative child would need.
paragraphs.zh: 马里拉轻轻叹了口气，意识到这个炽热、富有想象力的孩子需要多少耐心的引导。

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 8 章：安妮抚养计划的开始

paragraphs.en: The bringing-up of Anne Shirley began in earnest the following week at Green Gables.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来的一个星期，抚养安妮·雪莉的工作在绿山墙真正开始了。

paragraphs.en: Marilla sewed three plain, practical cotton dresses for Anne, without any ruffles or puffed sleeves.
paragraphs.zh: 马里拉为安妮缝制了三件朴素、实用的棉布连衣裙，没有任何花边或泡泡袖。

paragraphs.en: "They are very sensible, Marilla," Anne said politely, trying to hide her disappointment. "I shall just imagine that they are made of shimmering silk with gorgeous puffed sleeves!"
paragraphs.zh: “它们非常合体，马里拉，”安妮礼貌地说，试图掩饰她的失望。“我就想象它们是由闪光的丝绸制成的，带有华丽的泡泡袖！”

paragraphs.en: Marilla taught Anne how to bake bread, sew seams, and keep the kitchen spotless.
paragraphs.zh: 马里拉教安妮如何烤面包、缝制衣缝，并保持厨房纤尘不染。

paragraphs.en: Though Anne's mind often wandered into romantic daydreams—resulting in burnt puddings and misplaced thimbles—her eagerness to please Marilla warmed the quiet household.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然安妮的心思经常漂移到浪漫的白日梦中——导致烤糊了布丁和放错了顶针——但她急于讨好马里拉的热情温暖了平静的家庭。

chapters.title: Chapter 9: Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 9 章：雷切尔·林德太太惊呆了

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Rachel Lynde came over to Green Gables one evening to inspect the new orphan girl.
paragraphs.zh: 一天晚上，雷切尔·林德太太来到绿山墙考察新领养的孤儿女孩。

paragraphs.en: When Anne entered the kitchen, Mrs. Rachel scrutinized her from head to toe and remarked bluntly: "She's terribly skinny and homely, Marilla, and look at that hair as red as carrots!"
paragraphs.zh: 当安妮走进厨房时，雷切尔太太从头到脚审视着她，直言不讳地备注道：“她瘦得厉害，长得也丑，马里拉，看那头发红得像胡萝卜！”

paragraphs.en: Anne's face flushed with sudden fury. Stamping her foot, she flew at Mrs. Rachel in a storm of passion.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮的面容顿时因突如其来的怒火而发红。跺着脚，她以一阵暴风雨般的激情扑向雷切尔太太。

paragraphs.en: "I hate you!" Anne shrieked, her eyes flashing fire. "How dare you say I'm skinny and ugly and red-haired? You are a rude, impolite, unfeeling woman!"
paragraphs.zh: “我讨厌你！”安妮尖叫道，双眼闪烁着怒火。“你怎么敢说我瘦、丑和红头发？你是一个粗鲁、不礼貌、冷酷无情的女人！”

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Rachel gasped in utter horror, while Marilla stood frozen in shock at Anne's tempestuous outburst.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔太太惊恐地喘着气，而马里拉因安妮暴风雨般的爆发而吃惊地冻结在那里。

chapters.title: Chapter 10: Anne’s Apology
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 10 章：安妮的道歉

paragraphs.en: After Mrs. Rachel Lynde left Green Gables in high indignation, Marilla marched Anne up to her gable bedroom.
paragraphs.zh: 在雷切尔·林德太太无比愤慨地离开绿山墙后，马里拉把安妮带上了她的山墙卧室。

paragraphs.en: "You must stay in your room, Anne, until you are ready to apologize to Mrs. Rachel," Marilla said sternly.
paragraphs.zh: “你必须留在你的房间里，安妮，直到你准备好向雷切尔太太道歉，”马里拉严厉地说。

paragraphs.en: Anne spent the next day in solitude, refusing to eat or leave her room, clinging stubbornly to her hurt pride.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮在孤独中度过了接下来的天，拒绝吃东西或离开她的房间，顽固地坚守着她受伤害的骄傲。

paragraphs.en: However, when Matthew slipped upstairs at twilight and whispered, "Anne, just apologize for my sake," her heart melted instantly.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当马修在黄昏时分溜上楼轻声说：“安妮，为了我的缘故去道个歉吧，”她的心立刻融化了。

paragraphs.en: The next morning, Anne walked to Mrs. Rachel's house and delivered a dramatic, poetic apology that sounded like a speech from a romantic play.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天早晨，安妮走进雷切尔太太的家，递交了一份戏剧性、诗意十足的道歉，听起来就像浪漫剧里的台词。

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Rachel was so amused and touched that she readily forgave Anne, giving her a slice of plum cake as a token of peace.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔太太感到非常逗乐和感动，欣然原谅了安妮，给了她一片李子蛋糕作为和平的象征。

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Anne’s Impressions of Sunday School
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 11 章：安妮对主日学校的印象

paragraphs.en: The following Sunday, Anne attended Avonlea Sunday School for the very first time.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来的主日，安妮第一次参加了阿文莉主日学校。

paragraphs.en: She wore a plain black hat, which she had decorated with a wreath of wild buttercups and roses gathered along the road.
paragraphs.zh: 她戴着一顶朴素的黑帽子，上面装饰着沿途采摘的野毛茛和玫瑰花环。

paragraphs.en: Her appearance caused quite a sensation among the quiet Sunday school children.
paragraphs.zh: 她的出现引发了平静的主日学校孩子们相当大的轰动。

paragraphs.en: During the lesson, Anne found the teacher's lecture rather dry, but her imagination transformed the church windows into stained-glass portals to heaven.
paragraphs.zh: 在课上，安妮发现老师的讲课相当枯燥，但她的想象力把教堂的窗户化为了通往天堂的彩色玻璃门户。

paragraphs.en: "I didn't think much of Sunday school, Marilla," Anne reported frankly upon her return. "The superintendent asked too many questions, but I prayed for him in my heart anyway!"
paragraphs.zh: “我对主日学校评价不高，马里拉，”安妮回来后坦白地报告。“主管问了太多问题，但我还是在心里为他祷告了！”

chapters.title: Chapter 12: A Solemn Vow and Promise
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 12 章：庄严的誓言与承诺

paragraphs.en: That afternoon, Anne met Diana Barry, the black-haired girl who lived at Orchard Slope, for the first time.
paragraphs.zh: 那天下午，安妮第一次见到了住在果园坡的黑发女孩戴安娜·巴里。

paragraphs.en: The two girls walked down to the sparkling brook beneath the whispering birch trees.
paragraphs.zh: 两个女孩走到低语的桦树下闪光的小溪边。

paragraphs.en: "Will you swear to be my bosom friend forever and ever?" Anne asked solemnly, holding out her hands.
paragraphs.zh: “你愿意发誓永远做我的知心朋友吗？”安妮庄严地问，伸出双手。

paragraphs.en: Diana smiled warmly and took Anne's hands. "I promise to be faithful to you as long as the sun and moon endure."
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜温和地微笑，握住安妮的手。“我承诺只要太阳和月亮还在，我就对你忠诚。”

paragraphs.en: From that moment on, Anne and Diana became inseparable companions, sharing every secret, dream, and story in the enchanting woods of Avonlea.
paragraphs.zh: 从那一刻起，安妮和戴安娜成为了形影不离的伴侣，在阿文莉迷人的树林里分享着每一个秘密、梦想和故事。

chapters.title: Chapter 13: The Delight of Anticipation
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 13 章：期待的喜悦

paragraphs.en: August arrived, bringing news of the upcoming Sunday School Picnic at Carmody Lake.
paragraphs.zh: 八月到了，带来了即将到来的卡莫迪湖主日学校野餐的消息。

paragraphs.en: Anne was beside herself with excitement, especially when Marilla promised to bake an abundance of sweet biscuits and raspberry tarts for the feast.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮兴奋得忘乎所以，尤其是当马里拉承诺为盛宴烘焙大量的甜饼干和红莓塔时。

paragraphs.en: "I've never been to a picnic in my whole life, Marilla!" Anne exclaimed, clapping her hands. "I can hardly sleep for thinking of the ice cream!"
paragraphs.zh: “我一辈子都没去过野餐，马里拉！”安妮拍着手欢呼。“想到冰淇淋我都睡不着觉！”

paragraphs.en: Every day, Anne counted down the hours, imagining the boat rides across the blue lake and the laughter under the grand trees.
paragraphs.zh: 每天，安妮都倒数着时间，想象着在湛蓝湖面上划船和在大树下的欢笑。

paragraphs.en: Anticipation filled her days with pure, radiant joy.
paragraphs.zh: 期待在她的日子里充满了纯洁、灿烂的喜悦。

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Anne’s Confession
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 14 章：安妮的坦白

paragraphs.en: Two days before the picnic, Marilla discovered that her prized amethyst brooch was missing from her bureau drawer.
paragraphs.zh: 野餐前两天，马里拉发现她宝贵的紫水晶胸针从梳妆台抽屉里不翼而飞了。

paragraphs.en: Since Anne had admired the shining purple stone the previous evening, Marilla questioned her sternly.
paragraphs.zh: 由于安妮前一天晚上曾赞赏过那颗闪光的紫石头，马里拉严厉地询问了她。

paragraphs.en: "I only tried it on and put it back, Marilla!" Anne protested tearfully. "I swear I didn't lose it!"
paragraphs.zh: “我只是试戴了一下就放回去了，马里拉！”安妮流着泪抗议。“我发誓我没有丢！”

paragraphs.en: Believing Anne was lying, Marilla insisted that she would not go to the picnic until she confessed.
paragraphs.zh: 相信安妮在说谎，马里拉坚持在她坦白之前不准去野餐。

paragraphs.en: Desperate to attend the picnic, Anne fabricated a elaborate, dramatic confession of dropping the brooch into the harbor, leaving Marilla deeply dismayed.
paragraphs.zh: 急于参加野餐的安妮编造了一个精心构思的戏剧性坦白，说把胸针掉进了港口，让马里拉深感沮丧。

chapters.title: Chapter 15: A Tempest in the School Teapot
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 15 章：学校茶壶里的一场风波

paragraphs.en: Just as Marilla was about to enforce Anne's punishment, she found the amethyst brooch pinned to her black shawl, where it had accidentally caught.
paragraphs.zh: 正当马里拉要执行安妮的惩罚时，她在自己的黑色披肩上找到了紫水晶胸针，原来是意外挂在了上面。

paragraphs.en: Realizing Anne had confessed falsely just to go to the picnic, Marilla felt a wave of deep remorse for doubting the child's honesty.
paragraphs.zh: 意识到安妮只是为了去野餐而虚假坦白，马里拉为怀疑孩子的诚实而感到一阵深切的悔恨。

paragraphs.en: "I was wrong to disbelieve you, Anne," Marilla admitted warmly. "Get dressed—Matthew is waiting to drive you to Carmody Lake."
paragraphs.zh: “我不相信你是错的，安妮，”马里拉温和地承认。“穿好衣服——马修正等着驾车带你去卡莫迪湖呢。”

paragraphs.en: Anne rushed out to the buggy with joy in her heart, having the most glorious afternoon of her life, eating ice cream and riding boats with Diana.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮怀着心中的喜悦冲向马车，度过了她一生中最美好的下午，吃着冰淇淋，和戴安娜一起划船。

chapters.title: Chapter 16: Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 16 章：戴安娜受邀喝茶的悲剧结局

paragraphs.en: In September, Anne began attending Avonlea Public School under the instruction of Mr. Phillips.
paragraphs.zh: 九月，安妮开始在菲利普斯先生的指导下参加阿文莉公立学校。

paragraphs.en: She quickly excelled in reading and recitations, earning the admiration of her classmates.
paragraphs.zh: 她在朗读和背诵方面迅速脱颖而出，赢得了同学们的钦佩。

paragraphs.en: However, a rivalry flared when Gilbert Blythe, the handsomest and smartest boy in school, returned after a long absence.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当学校里最英俊、最聪明的男孩吉尔伯特·布莱斯在长期缺席后返回时，一场竞争爆发了。

paragraphs.en: Attempting to get Anne's attention during class, Gilbert picked up her long red braid and whispered playfully, "Carrots! Carrots!"
paragraphs.zh: 为了在课上引起安妮的注意，吉尔伯特拿起她长长的红辫子，开玩笑道：“胡萝卜！胡萝卜！”

paragraphs.en: Flashing with fury, Anne stood up, picked up her heavy slate, and cracked it over Gilbert's head, breaking the slate in two!
paragraphs.zh: 怒火中烧的安妮站起来，拿起她沉重的石板，在吉尔伯特的头上砸碎了，把石板一分为二！

chapters.title: Chapter 17: A New Interest in Life
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 17 章：生活中的新乐趣

paragraphs.en: One autumn afternoon, Marilla permitted Anne to invite Diana to Green Gables for an elegant afternoon tea.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个秋天的下午，马里拉允许安妮邀请戴安娜到绿山墙喝高雅的下午茶。

paragraphs.en: "You may serve the bottle of raspberry cordial on the second shelf of the pantry," Marilla instructed before leaving for town.
paragraphs.zh: “你可以享用膳食室第二层架子上的那瓶红莓果汁，”马里拉在去镇上之前指导道。

paragraphs.en: Anne proudly set the table with fine china and served the dark red liquid to Diana in glass goblets.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮自豪地用精美瓷器摆好桌子，把深红色的液体盛在玻璃高脚杯里递给戴安娜。

paragraphs.en: Diana found the drink delicious and drank three full glasses, but soon began feeling dizzy and unwell.
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜觉得这饮料很美味，喝了三大杯，但很快开始感到头晕不适。

paragraphs.en: Staggering home, Diana was diagnosed by her horrified mother as intoxicated—Anne had accidentally served Marilla's homemade currant wine instead of raspberry cordial!
paragraphs.zh: 踉跄着回到家，戴安娜被她惊恐的母亲诊断为醉酒——安妮不小心把马里拉自制的红醋栗酒当成红莓果汁给客人喝了！

chapters.title: Chapter 18: Anne to the Rescue
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 18 章：安妮的大营救

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Barry was so enraged by the wine incident that she strictly forbade Diana from ever speaking or playing with Anne again.
paragraphs.zh: 巴里太太因葡萄酒事件非常愤怒，严厉禁止戴安娜再与安妮说话或玩耍。

paragraphs.en: Heartbroken, Anne wept bitter tears, watching her dearest friend from afar across the orchard.
paragraphs.zh: 心碎的安妮流下了痛苦的眼泪，从果园对面遥望着她最亲爱的朋友。

paragraphs.en: A few weeks later, a severe epidemic of croup struck Avonlea, and Mr. and Mrs. Barry were away at a political rally in Charlottetown.
paragraphs.zh: 几周后，一场严重的哮吼流行病袭击了阿文莉，巴里先生和夫人远在夏洛特敦参加政治集会。

paragraphs.en: In the middle of the night, Diana ran to Green Gables in terror—her little sister Minnie May was choking with feverish croup.
paragraphs.zh: 在半夜里，戴安娜惊恐地跑向绿山墙——她的妹妹米妮·梅正因发烧的哮吼而窒息。

paragraphs.en: Using her experience from caring for twins in her past, Anne rushed over, prepared hot ipecac, and nursed Minnie May through the night, saving the child's life before the doctor arrived.
paragraphs.zh: 利用过去照顾双胞胎的经验，安妮冲了过去，准备了热吐根剂，护理米妮·梅度过了夜晚，在医生到达之前救了孩子的命。

chapters.title: Chapter 19: A Concert, a Catastrophe and a Confession
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 19 章：音乐会、大灾难与坦白

paragraphs.en: When Dr. Blair arrived at dawn, he commended Anne for her quick thinking and expert care, declaring that she had saved Minnie May's life.
paragraphs.zh: 当布莱尔医生在黎明到达时，他赞扬了安妮的快速思考和专业护理，声明她救了米妮·梅的命。

paragraphs.en: Deeply remorseful and grateful, Mrs. Barry came to Green Gables that afternoon to apologize to Anne with tears in her eyes.
paragraphs.zh: 深深悔恨和感激的巴里太太那天下午来到绿山墙，眼含热泪向安妮道歉。

paragraphs.en: "You may be bosom friends with Diana forever, Anne," Mrs. Barry declared, inviting Anne over for a celebratory supper.
paragraphs.zh: “你可以永远做戴安娜的知心朋友，安妮，”巴里太太声明，邀请安妮过去吃庆祝晚餐。

paragraphs.en: Anne and Diana embraced with joyous tears, their precious friendship restored stronger than ever before.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮和戴安娜带着喜悦的眼泪拥抱在一起，她们宝贵的友谊恢复得比以往任何时候都更加牢固。

chapters.title: Chapter 20: A Good Imagination Gone Wrong
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 20 章：走偏了的丰富想象力

paragraphs.en: Winter brought a series of literary adventures as Anne, Diana, Jane Andrews, and Ruby Gillis formed the 'Avonlea Story Club'.
paragraphs.zh: 冬天带来了一系列文学冒险，安妮、戴安娜、珍·安德鲁斯和鲁比·吉利斯组成了‘阿文莉故事俱乐部’。

paragraphs.en: Together, they wrote romantic, dramatic tales of tragic lovers, noble knights, and mysterious maidens in distress.
paragraphs.zh: 她们一起创作了浪漫、戏剧性的悲剧恋人、高尚骑士和陷入困境的神秘少女的故事。

paragraphs.en: Anne's vivid imagination produced the most popular stories, filled with poetic heartbreak and happy endings.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮丰富的想象力创造出了最受欢迎的故事，充满了诗意的心碎和幸福的结局。

paragraphs.en: "It's so wonderful to write down all the beautiful thoughts in your heart," Anne remarked, her eyes glowing with creative fire.
paragraphs.zh: “把心中所有美好的想法写下来真是太棒了，”安妮备注道，她的眼睛里闪烁着创作的火花。

chapters.title: Chapter 21: A New Departure in Flavoring
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 21 章：调味品的新风波

paragraphs.en: Spring arrived at Green Gables, bringing new life to the orchard and pastures.
paragraphs.zh: 春天来到了绿山墙，给果园和牧场带来了新生。

paragraphs.en: Anne's lively imagination occasionally led her into trouble, such as when she believed the Haunted Wood was filled with white-robed ghosts and wailing spirits.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮活泼的想象力偶尔会给她带来麻烦，比如当她相信鬼林里充满了穿白袍的鬼魂和号哭的灵体时。

paragraphs.en: Marilla gently reminded Anne to anchor her imagination in truth and common sense.
paragraphs.zh: 马里拉温和地提醒安妮把她的想象力锚定在真理和常识中。

paragraphs.en: Through every misadventure, Matthew's quiet encouragement and Marilla's steady love guided Anne toward thoughtful maturity.
paragraphs.zh: 通过每一次遭遇，马修安静的鼓励和马里拉稳定的爱指导着安妮走向周到的成熟。

chapters.title: Chapter 22: Anne Is Invited Out to Tea
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 22 章：安妮受邀去喝茶

paragraphs.en: When the new minister, Mr. Allan, and his sweet wife Mrs. Allan visited Green Gables for tea, Anne baked a special layer cake.
paragraphs.zh: 当新牧师阿兰先生和他甜蜜的妻子阿兰太太拜访绿山墙喝茶时，安妮烘焙了一块特殊的夹心蛋糕。

paragraphs.en: However, when Mrs. Allan took a bite, her face twisted in surprise—Anne had accidentally used liniment oil instead of vanilla extract for flavoring!
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当阿兰太太咬了一口时，她的脸因惊讶而扭曲——安妮不小心用了擦剂油而不是香草精来调味！

paragraphs.en: Though mortified, Anne was comforted by Mrs. Allan's gentle laughter and kindness.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然感到屈辱，安妮还是被阿兰太太温和的笑声和善良所安慰。

paragraphs.en: The two became fast friends, inspiring Anne to strive for goodness and grace.
paragraphs.zh: 两人成为了迅速的朋友，激励着安妮追求善良与优雅。

chapters.title: Chapter 23: Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 23 章：安妮在荣誉决斗中失利

paragraphs.en: During the summer, a traveling peddler sold Anne a bottle of hair dye promised to turn her red hair into a raven black.
paragraphs.zh: 在夏天，一个流动货郎卖给安妮一瓶染发剂，承诺把她的红头发变成乌黑。

paragraphs.en: Instead, the dye turned Anne's hair a terrible, hideous shade of dull green!
paragraphs.zh: 然而，染发剂把安妮的头发变成了可怕、丑陋的暗绿色！

paragraphs.en: After trying desperately to wash it out, Anne had no choice but to let Marilla crop her hair short.
paragraphs.zh: 在拼命试图洗掉之后，安妮别无选择，只能让马里拉把她的头发剪短。

paragraphs.en: "It is a lesson in humility, Marilla," Anne accepted with a sigh, looking at her short curls in the mirror.
paragraphs.zh: “这是一堂谦逊课，马里拉，”安妮带着叹息接受道，在镜子里看着她的短卷发。

chapters.title: Chapter 24: Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 24 章：史塔西小姐与学生们的筹备音乐会

paragraphs.en: At a party with her schoolmates, Anne accepted a dare from Josie Pye to walk along the ridgepole of the Barrys' roof.
paragraphs.zh: 在与同学们的派对上，安妮接受了乔西·派的挑战，沿着巴里家屋顶的屋脊走。

paragraphs.en: Slipping on the shingles, Anne fell to the ground, breaking her ankle in the tumble.
paragraphs.zh: 在木瓦上滑倒，安妮跌落到地上，在摔倒中折断了脚踝。

paragraphs.en: Matthew picked her up gently and carried her home to Green Gables.
paragraphs.zh: 马修温和地抱起她，把她抱回绿山墙。

paragraphs.en: During her weeks of recovery, the whole neighborhood visited with flowers and treats, realizing how deeply they loved the sweet, imaginative girl.
paragraphs.zh: 在她康复的几周里，整个街区都带着鲜花和甜食来拜访，意识到他们是多么深爱这个甜美、富有想象力的女孩。

chapters.title: Chapter 25: Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 25 章：马修坚持要泡泡袖

paragraphs.en: The arrival of a new teacher, Miss Stacy, transformed Avonlea school into a place of inspiration and academic excellence.
paragraphs.zh: 新老师史塔西小姐的到来把阿文莉学校转化为了一个灵感和学术卓越的地方。

paragraphs.en: Miss Stacy organized nature walks, physical exercises, and a grand Christmas concert to raise money for a school flag.
paragraphs.zh: 史塔西小姐组织了自然漫步、体育锻炼和一个宏大的圣诞音乐会，为学校旗帜筹集资金。

paragraphs.en: Anne recited 'Bernardo del Carpio' with such dramatic passion that the audience applauded enthusiastically.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮以如此戏剧性的激情背诵了《贝尔纳多·德尔·卡皮奥》，以至于观众热烈掌声。

paragraphs.en: Under Miss Stacy's guidance, Anne set her heart on preparing for the entrance examinations for Queen's Academy.
paragraphs.zh: 在史塔西小姐的指导下，安妮立志准备皇后学院的入学考试。

chapters.title: Chapter 26: The Story Club Is Formed
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 26 章：故事俱乐部的诞生

paragraphs.en: As Christmas approached, Matthew noticed that Anne's dresses were plain and outdated compared to those of her friends.
paragraphs.zh: 随着圣诞节的临近，马修注意到安妮的连衣裙与她朋友们的相比显得朴素而出塌。

paragraphs.en: Determined to give her something special, Matthew secretly ordered a fashionably made dress with splendid puffed sleeves from Mrs. Lynde.
paragraphs.zh: 决心给她一些特别的东西，马修秘密地从林德太太那里订购了一件款式时尚、带有华丽泡泡袖的连衣裙。

paragraphs.en: On Christmas morning, when Anne unwrapped the beautiful brown silk dress with puffed sleeves, tears of joy filled her eyes.
paragraphs.zh: 在圣诞节早晨，当安妮拆开带泡泡袖的漂亮棕色丝绸连衣裙时，喜悦的眼泪填满了她的眼睛。

paragraphs.en: "It's the most exquisite dress in the whole world, Matthew!" she cried, throwing her arms around his neck.
paragraphs.zh: “这是全天下最精美的连衣裙，马修！”她哭喊着，双手环绕着他的脖子。

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Vanity and Vexation of Spirit
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 27 章：虚荣与灵魂的烦恼

paragraphs.en: The Story Club continued to flourish, meeting in the woods to read their poetic compositions.
paragraphs.zh: 故事俱乐部继续蓬勃发展，在树林里聚会阅读她们的诗意创作。

paragraphs.en: Anne's writing showed a growing maturity and a deep appreciation for the beauty of Prince Edward Island.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮的写作展现出日益成熟和对爱德华王子岛美丽的深切赞赏。

paragraphs.en: Her stories reflected the love and peace she had found at Green Gables under Matthew and Marilla's care.
paragraphs.zh: 她的故事反映了她在马修和马里拉的照料下在绿山墙找到的爱与和平。

chapters.title: Chapter 28: An Unfortunate Lily Maid
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 28 章：不幸的百合少女

paragraphs.en: One summer afternoon, Anne and her friends decided to reenact Tennyson's poem 'Lancelot and Elaine' on the pond.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个夏天的下午，安妮和她的朋友们决定在池塘上重演丁尼生的诗歌《兰斯洛特与埃兰妮》。

paragraphs.en: Anne lay in a flat-bottomed dory as the Lily Maid, floating down the stream with a black shawl over her dress.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮躺在一条平底平底船上作为百合少女，身上披着黑色披肩顺流飘下。

paragraphs.en: However, the boat began leaking rapidly, sinking in the middle of the pond!
paragraphs.zh: 然而，船开始快速漏水，在池塘中央下沉！

paragraphs.en: Anne managed to cling to a wooden bridge pile until Gilbert Blythe rowed past in his boat and rescued her.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮成功紧紧抓住一根木桥桩，直到吉尔伯特·布莱斯划着他的船经过并救了她。

paragraphs.en: Though Gilbert offered a sincere truce and friendship, Anne's pride kept her from accepting, a decision she later regretted.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然吉尔伯特提供了真诚的休战和友谊，安妮的骄傲使她没有接受，这是一个她后来后悔的决定。

chapters.title: Chapter 29: An Epoch in Anne’s Life
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 29 章：安妮生命中的里程碑

paragraphs.en: Autumn brought hard work as Miss Stacy formed a special advanced class to prepare students for the Queen's Academy examination.
paragraphs.zh: 秋天带来了艰苦的工作，史塔西小姐组成了一个特别的高级班，为学生们准备皇后学院考试。

paragraphs.en: Anne, Gilbert, Diana, Jane, and Ruby spent long evenings studying Latin, geometry, and English literature.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮、吉尔伯特、戴安娜、珍和鲁比度过了长长的夜晚学习拉丁语、几何学和英国文学。

paragraphs.en: The friendly academic rivalry between Anne and Gilbert pushed both of them to achieve their absolute highest potential.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮和吉尔伯特之间友好的学术竞争推动着他们两人实现绝对最高的潜力。

chapters.title: Chapter 30: The Queens Class Is Formed
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 30 章：皇后学院预备班的建立

paragraphs.en: In June, Anne and her classmates traveled to Charlottetown for the intense three-day Queen's entrance exams.
paragraphs.zh: 六月，安妮和她的同学们前往夏洛特敦参加紧张的三天皇后学院入学考试。

paragraphs.en: Waiting for the results was a nerve-wracking ordeal for everyone in Avonlea.
paragraphs.zh: 等待结果对阿文莉的每个人来说都是一场折磨神经的考验。

paragraphs.en: One evening, Diana ran across the orchard shouting, "Anne, you've passed! You and Gilbert tied for first place in all the Island!"
paragraphs.zh: 一天晚上，戴安娜穿过果园跑着喊道：“安妮，你通过了！你和吉尔伯特全岛并列第一名！”

paragraphs.en: Green Gables erupted in celebration as Matthew and Marilla beamed with immense pride for their beloved girl.
paragraphs.zh: 绿山墙爆发出了庆祝，马修和马里拉为她们宝贝的女孩感到无比自豪。

chapters.title: Chapter 31: Where the Brook and River Meet
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 31 章：溪流与江河汇合之处

paragraphs.en: That summer, Anne enjoyed her final weeks of childhood before departing for Charlottetown.
paragraphs.zh: 那个夏天，安妮在前往夏洛特敦之前享受了她童年的最后几周。

paragraphs.en: She spent long hours wandering through Lover's Lane, drinking in the familiar beauty of Avonlea.
paragraphs.zh: 她花长长的时间在情侣路漫步，饮入阿文莉熟悉的细致美丽。

paragraphs.en: Her bond with Matthew and Marilla grew deeper, filled with quiet understanding and deep affection.
paragraphs.zh: 她与马修和马里拉的纽带变得更深，充满了安静的理解和深切的情感。

chapters.title: Chapter 32: The Pass List Is Out
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 32 章：录取名单公布了

paragraphs.en: In September, Anne moved to Charlottetown to begin her studies at Queen's Academy.
paragraphs.zh: 九月，安妮搬到夏洛特敦开始在皇后学院学习。

paragraphs.en: Though homesick at first, she threw herself into her studies, aiming for the prestigious Avery Scholarship.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然起初想家，但她投身于学习中，目标是渴望得到的艾弗里奖学金。

paragraphs.en: Her intelligence and warmth earned her many new friends and the respect of her professors.
paragraphs.zh: 她的聪慧和温暖赢得了许多新朋友和教授们的尊重。

chapters.title: Chapter 33: The Hotel Concert
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 33 章：饭店里的音乐盛会

paragraphs.en: Winter at Queen's was intense as Anne worked tirelessly toward the final examinations.
paragraphs.zh: 皇后学院的冬天很紧张，因为安妮不知疲倦地朝最终考试努力。

paragraphs.en: She maintained her academic rivalry with Gilbert, each inspiring the other to brilliant achievements.
paragraphs.zh: 她保持着与吉尔伯特的学术竞争，彼此激励走向辉煌的成就。

chapters.title: Chapter 34: A Queen’s Girl
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 34 章：皇后学院的女学生

paragraphs.en: At the commencement ceremony, the results were announced amidst great anticipation.
paragraphs.zh: 在毕业典礼上，结果在巨大的期待中公布了。

paragraphs.en: Anne Shirley won the coveted Avery Scholarship, providing four years of tuition at Redmond College!
paragraphs.zh: 安妮·雪莉赢得了令人垂涎的艾弗里奖学金，提供红蒙德学院四年的学费！

paragraphs.en: Gilbert Blythe won the Prince of Wales Gold Medal for general academic excellence.
paragraphs.zh: 吉尔伯特·布莱斯赢得了威尔士王子金质奖章，以表彰通用的学术卓越。

paragraphs.en: Matthew and Marilla watched from the audience, tears of joy streaming down their faces as Anne took the stage.
paragraphs.zh: 马修和马里拉在观众席上看着，当安妮登台时喜悦的眼泪流下双颊。

chapters.title: Chapter 35: The Winter at Queen’s
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 35 章：在皇后学院的冬天

paragraphs.en: Anne returned to Green Gables for the summer, a poised, educated young woman of seventeen.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮返回绿山墙度过夏天，成为一位十七岁沉着、受过良好教育的年轻女子。

paragraphs.en: Though tall and refined, her warm heart and bright spirit remained unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然高大而精致，但她温暖的心和明亮的灵魂保持不变。

chapters.title: Chapter 36: The Glory and the Dream
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 36 章：荣耀与梦想

paragraphs.en: Tragedy struck Green Gables shortly after Anne's return when Matthew Cuthbert suffered a sudden heart attack after reading news of the bank failure.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮返回后不久，当马修·卡斯伯特在读到银行倒闭的消息后突发心脏病时，悲剧袭击了绿山墙。

paragraphs.en: Matthew passed away quietly, leaving Anne and Marilla heartbroken with grief.
paragraphs.zh: 马修安静地过世了，留下了心碎悲伤的安妮和马里拉。

paragraphs.en: The whole town of Avonlea mourned the loss of the quiet, gentle man who had loved Anne so deeply.
paragraphs.zh: 整个阿文莉小镇都在哀悼失去了这位如此深爱安妮的安静、温和的男人。

chapters.title: Chapter 37: The Reaper Whose Name Is Death
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 37 章：名为死亡的割麦人

paragraphs.en: Following Matthew's death, Marilla faced the threat of losing her failing eyesight, making it impossible to manage Green Gables alone.
paragraphs.zh: 在马修去世后，马里拉面临着失去衰退视力的威胁，使她无法独自打理绿山墙。

paragraphs.en: To save Green Gables, Anne selflessly gave up her Avery Scholarship to stay home and care for Marilla.
paragraphs.zh: 为了挽救绿山墙，安妮无私地放弃了她的艾弗里奖学金，留在家中照顾马里拉。

paragraphs.en: Learning of her sacrifice, Gilbert Blythe generously gave up his appointment as Avonlea school teacher so Anne could teach close to home.
paragraphs.zh: 了解到她的牺牲，吉尔伯特·布莱斯慷慨地放弃了他作为阿文莉学校教师的任命，以便安妮可以在家附近教书。

chapters.title: Chapter 38: The Bend in the Road
chapters.chineseTitle: 第 38 章：路途上的弯道

paragraphs.en: When Anne met Gilbert on the road near the orchard, she thanked him with deep gratitude for his generous sacrifice.
paragraphs.zh: 当安妮在果园附近的公路上遇到吉尔伯特时，她以深切的感激感谢他的慷慨牺牲。

paragraphs.en: Gilbert smiled warmly, offering his hand in true, lasting friendship.
paragraphs.zh: 吉尔伯特温和地微笑，在真实、持久的友谊中伸出了他的手。

paragraphs.en: "We were born to be friends, Anne," he said softly.
paragraphs.zh: “我们生来就是做朋友的，安妮，”他轻声说。

paragraphs.en: Anne took his hand happily, knowing that a wonderful new chapter of their lives was beginning.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮快乐地握住他的手，知道她们生活的一个美好的新章节正在开始。
